item.title: About Us
item.description:
Niyati Chem Labs is a Mumbai-based manufacturer of herbal ayurvedic products and dietary supplements. We started operations in 2012, and we have built the business on two ordinary things: transparent dealings, and delivering inside the timeframe we commit to.

Production runs from two units, at Vasai in Maharashtra and at Navsari in Gujarat. Between them they cover the full cycle — product development, granulation, compression and encapsulation, filling, packing, labelling and dispatch — with enough on-site storage that a repeat order does not sit waiting on procurement.

item.title: Certification
item.description:
Note for review: the three certificate panels above are placeholders. The real scans go in once they are issued in the company’s own name — replace the files in static/img/cert/ and update the image: lines in this page’s settings block.

Certification is the result of a routine, not a substitute for one. Every consignment of raw material is analysed on arrival — identity, purity and, where relevant, assay of the marker compound — before it is accepted into stores. Material that fails specification is rejected rather than reworked.
